summary: Verstappen arrives in Singapore hunting a third consecutive sprint victory, with Ferrari's Leclerc lurking as the primary threat after qualifying delivered pole position to the Red Bull ace by mere hundredths. Russell's Mercedes machinery showed early pace in practice but the British driver's sprint-race crash leaves questions about consistency and setup balance as the main 72-lap feature looms. A commanding performance Sunday would extend Verstappen's championship buffer and potentially seal mathematical elimination of his closest rivals before the season's final stretch.
